name: yoga-break
description: Suggests a short yoga clip that fits into the time a long turn or tool call leaves you waiting.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the mod's texts: en (default) or de. /yoga lang de switches too.

playlist.title: Playlist link
playlist.description: A playlist link from Yoga Clips (https://yoga-clips.le-space.de/?db=/orbitdb/...). When set, a clip opens there in the player instead of at its own address. /yoga playlist <link> sets it too.
